title: MUSCLE MANGA - Yujiro Hanma's Physique in Grappler Baki (part. 1)
summary: Narrated breakdown of Yujiro Hanma's Vietnam War flashback in Grappler Baki, told through Jack Hanma's mother's memory. NH comments on Yujiro's physique (huge frame, V-taper, yoke and neck at 16), the manga's political subtext about the war, and how Yujiro embodies masculinity pushed to a monstrous extreme.
claims: At 16 Yujiro already carries more muscle than any 30-year-old could dream of, with a neck thick enough to shame dedicated yoke trainers
Yujiro's frame is so wide relative to his narrow waist that he looks almost alien; these are 'Yujiro proportions' beyond GI Joe proportions
At a height of at least 6'2" (up to 6'5"), Yujiro packs an insane amount of mass on a large frame, unlike the short Baki; shoulders and yoke look ridiculous
Despite its reputation for brainless violence, Grappler Baki is stuffed with political messages, such as a single guerrilla fighter making the US army retreat in Vietnam
Yujiro differs from Baki in that his love of combat is sadistic and deviant, while Baki's is pure

Yujiro represents masculinity pushed to an inhuman extreme: biggest, most shredded body and androgenic traits, but also a psychopath without empathy, which makes his 'strongest creature' title believable
Big lats are important, but character believability matters more
